title: Is first-line single-agent mitoxantrone in the treatment of high-risk metastatic breast cancer patients as effective as combination chemotherapy? No difference in survival but higher quality of life were found in a multicenter randomized trial.
abstract: To determine whether patients with high-risk metastatic breast cancer draw benefit from combination chemotherapy as first-line treatment.
journal: Annals of oncology : official journal of the European Society for Medical Oncology
